newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stock index takes marginal fall in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stock index takes marginal fall in week.

text.p: Bahrain stocks fell in the week to Thursday, with the index slipping to 1,539.91 from 1,540.93 a week earlier, the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said.
The exchange said trade volume climbed to 13.4 million shares from 7.7 million shares a week earlier. The value of stocks traded rose to 2.23 million dinars ($5.9 million) from 1.69 million dinars.
Shares of 26 firms of the 39 registered at the exchange were traded, up from 20 a week ago.
The commercial banking sector dominated trade, the BSE said.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank was the most active player, with shares worth 498,879 dinars changing hands.
Bahrain Middle East Bank came next, with shares worth 455,915 dinars traded.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
